messages:
emma_cs: Hey team — Orion QBR is scheduled for Tue 4/12 9:00am PT. Final slide deck due EOD Fri. High-level asks: slide owners, any blockers, and a short renewal ask (exec-ready). Usage is down ~28% QoQ — renewal looks at-risk. Please reply with: 1) which slide you own 2) data or inputs you need 3) availability for a dry run (Mon 4/11).

sophie_pm: I can own the onboarding metrics slide (slide 2). Need the cohort retention chart (30/60/90) + signup -> activation funnel. Can someone export the segmentation by plan? @miguel_sre or @raj_eng? :mag:

raj_eng: I'll take perf + infra (slide 3). Need last 30d p95/p99 latency and cost per 1k tokens. Miguel — can you run the p95 trace query and share grafana link?

miguel_sre: Yep — I can pull traces and add an SLO chart for p95 (30d). I need query access to the billing dataset to compute cost per 1k tokens. @sophie_pm what dataset name do you use for onboarding cohorts?

sophie_pm: dataset name is analytics.onboard_v2. Also will need the activation event mapping: event.activate_v2.

jessica_re: I'll prepare the renewal ask + exec talking points (slide 4). Need net revenue retention by ARR band and the top 3 support tickets this quarter. If usage is down, we should surface top causes and a short remediation plan.

emma_cs: Adding a quick owner map here so we don't lose track: 
```
Slide owners:
1 - emma_cs (overview + exec TL;DR)
2 - sophie_pm (onboarding metrics)
3 - raj_eng (perf + infra)
4 - jessica_re (renewal ask + exec talking points)
5 - miguel_sre (support trends + SLOs)
```

emma_cs: Dry run proposal: Mon 4/11 10:00am PT (30–40m). Can people confirm availability? If you can't make it, please prerecord your demo or share notes.

raj_eng: Confirmed for dry run. I'll also add a one-slide fallback: degraded demo flow + mitigation steps.

miguel_sre: Confirmed. I'll drop the grafana link and the query in the thread when ready. ETA Thu EOD for the charts.

sophie_pm: Confirmed. I'll also attach the customer cohort CSV to the drive and tag owners. ETA Thu noon.

jessica_re: I can make the dry run but prefer 11am if that helps execs. If not, I'm ok with 10am. Will share renewal ask doc (one-pager) by Fri noon.

emma_cs: Noted — 10am stands for majority. @jessica_re if you need an extra 30m before execs we can do a short sync Tue AM.

qbr-bot: Reminder scheduled: Deck due by Fri 11:59pm PT. Dry run meeting created: Mon 4/11 10:00am PT — calendar invites sent.

emma_cs: Action items recap (quick):
- sophie_pm: upload cohort CSV + funnel (Thu noon)
- miguel_sre: p95/p99 + SLO charts + grafana link (Thu EOD)
- raj_eng: slide 3 draft + fallback slide (Mon morning)
- jessica_re: renewal ask one-pager + exec bullets (Fri noon)
- emma_cs: consolidate slides, run deck QC, confirm exec attendees (Fri EOD)

emma_cs: Any blockers or risks we should call out now? If renewal is at-risk we should surface a short win plan (20–30 day mitigation) and a clear ask (discount / success credits / focused enablement).

jessica_re: I'll draft two ask options (conservative/soft and escalated) so execs can choose.

sophie_pm: Risk: cohort shipped a product change in Nov that likely impacted activation — I can annotate that on the onboarding slide.

emma_cs: Great — thanks everyone. I'll capture these in the deck and tag owners on each slide. If anything else pops up, drop it here. :thumbsup:
